framework: IFBench-style instruction generalization (NeurIPS 2025: models strongly overfit a small set of verifiable constraints)
description: 20 NEW constraint templates that appear NOWHERE in tests/eval-suite-v1.json, the baseline artifacts, or the system prompt. The v1 instruction suite measures 10 SEEN constraints (I11-I20); this suite measures whether the model can follow UNSEEN verifiable constraints. Every case carries a deterministic grader (pure string function over the answer, no judge) plus graderSelfTests: hermetic fixtures the grader must pass and fail before the suite ever runs against a model. NOT YET RUN against a model (quota) — the graders themselves are testable offline now.
graderSource: src/lib/eval-grader.ts evalAssertion() — same core the v1 suite uses
hermeticCheck: bun scripts/test-instruction-graders.ts — verifies every grader against its self-test fixtures (must exit 0)
unseenConstraintGuarantee: Template list checked against eval-suite-v1.json INSTRUCTION cases (I11-I20), baseline-v1/v2/v3 artifacts and the production SYSTEM_PROMPT: no overlap. G07 uses the word 'banana' like I11 but a DIFFERENT constraint shape (occurrence count vs single-word reply).

cases.prompt: Write a sentence where every word starts with S.

pass: She sells sea shells swiftly.
Sixty sailors sing softly, smiling.

cases.prompt: Use exactly three commas in your response.

pass: One, two, three, and done.
A, B, C, that is all.
fail: A, B, C, D, that is all.

cases.prompt: End your response with a question mark.

pass: Here is the answer you asked for, okay?
Pretty neat, right?

cases.prompt: Do not use the letter e anywhere in your response.

pass: A hot dog is a good snack.
Try this: pop music.

cases.prompt: Write your response in all lowercase.

pass: this is entirely lowercase.
ok fine 123 let's go.

cases.prompt: Every sentence must be under 10 words.

pass: Short sentence here. Another short one! Last one.
fail: This particular sentence goes on for well over the ten word limit stated.

cases.prompt: Include the word 'banana' exactly twice in your response.

pass: I ate a banana and then another banana today.
Banana bread uses one banana per loaf.

cases.prompt: Answer in bullet points, no more than 3.

pass:
- first point
- second point
- third point
* one thing only
fail: plain prose, no bullets at all

cases.prompt: Write in the style of a pirate.

pass: Arr, that be the treasure ye sought, matey!
Ahoy, welcome aboard the good ship.
fail: Here is your answer in plain modern English.

cases.prompt: Use only one-syllable words in your response.

pass: The dog ran fast to get its ball.
One two three, go go go!

cases.prompt: Write your response as exactly two sentences.

pass: Here is the first one. And here is the second.

cases.prompt: Start your response with the word Clearly.

pass: Clearly, the answer is yes.
Clearly the data supports this.

cases.prompt: Do not use the word 'the' anywhere in your response.

pass: A cat sat on a mat.
Theme parks are fun!
fail: The cat sat on the mat.

cases.prompt: Every word must be at least 4 letters long.

pass: Every single word here stretches four letters minimum.
Explaining things takes wonderful, elaborate wording.

cases.prompt: Use no more than 20 words in your entire response.

pass: One two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve thirteen fourteen fifteen sixteen seventeen eighteen nineteen twenty
fail: One two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve thirteen fourteen fifteen sixteen seventeen eighteen nineteen twenty twentyone

cases.prompt: Separate your sentences with semicolons instead of periods.

pass: Here comes one thought; here comes another
One sentence; another one

cases.prompt: Spell the word echo backwards somewhere in your response.

pass: Echo spelled in reverse reads ohce.
The mirror form is ohce, fun fact.

cases.prompt: Use exactly two exclamation marks in your response.

pass: Wow! That is great! Truly.
Yes! Absolutely!

cases.prompt: Put your entire answer inside double quotes.

pass: "Here is the answer, quoted as asked."
fail: Here is "an answer" with inner quotes only.

cases.prompt: Number every sentence in your response, starting from 1.

pass: 1. First thought comes here. 2. Second thought follows it. 3. Third closes it out.
